name: aml-typology-vop-mismatch-hunt
title: AML Typology VoP Mismatch Hunt
description: Score a synthetic transaction graph against AML typologies, then run a separate SEPA IBAN-name match batch over payee records the caller selects from the flagged accounts, and close with a session receipt. Each run computes from its own declared inputs, and each run hash is cited in the session receipt.

steps.handoff: Typology risk scores per transaction with per-typology hit counts, plus flagged accounts and clusters from a synthetic transaction graph. Stage 1 of 3. Its execution hash is cited in the session receipt.

Batch IBAN-name match, close-match and no-match counts with the match rate at the declared strictness, over payee records the caller selects from the flagged accounts. Stage 2 of 3. Its execution hash is cited in the session receipt.

Session receipt: one SHA-256 Merkle root over the ordered execution hashes of the runs above, with per-leaf inclusion proofs. Terminal stage. This step aggregates hashes and carries no compute proof of its own.
